channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro teve 2 projetos aprovados no Senado em 7 anos de mandato
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL-RJ pre-candidate for presidency, had only two bills approved in the Senate over seven years of mandate, none related to public security, his main policy focus. Out of 62 proposals, he authored and reported fewer bills than most of his peers, indicating low legislative productivity.

item.title: Senador diz que reportagem induz a leitura incompleta e destaca emendas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) had only two bill approvals as primary author during seven years in Congress, according to a UOL survey. He criticizes the report for promoting incomplete reading and emphasizes that his amendments were approved, even if the bills did not become law.

item.title: Indústria defende cashback da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: Textile industry and digital platform associations support Bill PLC 22/2026, which proposes a cashback of 50% on CBS and 20% on IBS for low-income families registered in CadÚnico when purchasing clothing and home textiles. The initiative aims to promote formalization, increase fiscal receipts, and create jobs following the repeal of the 'blusinhas tax' by President Lula in May 2026.

item.title: A crise interna e o desgaste externo que cercam pré-campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign faces internal challenges, particularly due to his fraternal relationship with Daniel Vorcaro, and external wear that complicate his electoral trajectory. The content notes that the full article is available only to subscribers, restricting access to detailed information about the crisis.

item.title: ‘Dark Horse’: orçamento do filme secou quando Bolsonaro foi preso e produção pediu corte de gastos
item.description: The production of the film 'Dark Horse', depicting Jair Bolsonaro's political trajectory, faced budget cuts after his arrest in November 2023, according to crew reports. Producer GoUp reduced spending in areas like production and art, after initially negotiating up to R$134 million with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro. Filming was shifted from Argentina and Uruguay to São Paulo due to budget concerns, and the film's budget exceeds that of Brazilian Oscar-contenders like 'Still Here' and 'The Secret Agent'.

item.title: Os patriotas pelo avesso
item.description: Bolsonarista protesters displayed the U.S. flag on Paulista Avenue during Brazil's Patriot Day, calling themselves 'patriots' while advocating policies that harm Brazil, such as trade barriers and foreign intervention in national elections. This behavior reveals a contradiction between nationalist rhetoric and actions serving foreign interests, threatening Brazil's sovereignty and democratic institutions.

item.title: Lula amplia crédito com taxas favorecidas em terceiro mandato, preocupa BC e pressiona juros
item.description: The rise in directed credit with subsidized interest rates during Lula's third term is pressuring the Central Bank to keep the Selic rate at 14.5% annually, according to BC data. This type of credit, which benefits from government subsidies and long-term guarantees, reduces the effectiveness of monetary policy by decoupling a portion of lending from the benchmark rate, forcing the BC to maintain high interest rates to curb inflation. The April Copom minutes warn that growing directed credit and public debt uncertainties could raise the economy's neutral interest rate, undermining disinflation efforts.

item.title: Deolane e Vorcaro vão poder votar? Entenda como funcionam as eleições para presos provisórios
item.description: Provisional detainees in Brazil retain the right to vote, as political rights are only suspended after a final criminal conviction. Despite preventive detentions, such as those of Deolane Bezerra and Daniel Vorcaro, they may still vote in the 2026 elections if not yet definitively convicted. The TSE ruled that the Anti-Faction Law, which sought to suspend this right, cannot be applied in 2026 due to violating the principle of annual electoral rules.

item.title: Soberania x terrorismo: Lula e Flávio buscam ganho eleitoral com estratégias opostas após decisão dos EUA sobre CV e PCC
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are pursuing opposing electoral strategies following the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. Lula is emphasizing national sovereignty, replicating the effective approach used during Trump’s tariff surge, while Flávio aims to portray the president as lenient on crime. With public security being voters’ top concern, the Lula administration is attempting to balance condemnation of criminal factions with a narrative of resisting foreign interference.

item.title: Entrevista: 'Alcolumbre quer sentar com Lula e recompor a relação', afirma o ministro José Guimarães
item.description: Minister José Guimarães states that Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is willing to rebuild his relationship with President Lula and should not block the vote on the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale in the Senate, despite political tensions. Guimarães notes the government has 'regained its footing' after the defeat of Jorge Messias' STF nomination and believes the proposal, supported by over 70% of the population, will advance through dialogue, as Alcolumbre remains open to daily talks and desires to meet with Lula.

item.title: Classificação de facções como terroristas abre novo capítulo de tensão na relação diplomática entre Brasil e EUA
item.description: The U.S. government designated the Comando Vermelho and Primeiro Comando da Capital as terrorist groups, a move the Brazilian Foreign Ministry unsuccessfully tried to prevent. Experts say the impact exceeds that of Trump’s tariffs, as it opens legal avenues for U.S. interference in Brazilian sectors like banking and security, though practical application remains uncertain. Brazil should focus on direct dialogue between Lula and Trump to mitigate damage, emphasizing American investors’ interests in the country.

item.title: Voto nos estados: com tensão entre aliados e oposição mirando escândalo, Master estará no centro da disputa no DF
item.description: Vice-governor Celina Leão and Governor Ibaneis Rocha held a press conference in Brasília regarding the governor's return to office following a ruling by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The text highlights tensions between allies and opposition, with 'Master' (likely referring to a scheme or figure tied to scandals) positioned at the center of the political dispute in the Federal District. The context involves scandals polarizing the local electoral landscape.

item.title: Lula 3 e Congresso deixam de herança quase R$ 1 tri na conta de luz
item.description: A survey by the National Front of Energy Consumers indicates that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's third term and the current legislature of the National Congress have created an extra expense of R$ 985 billion on electricity bills through 2050. The amount refers to additional costs stemming from energy policies and legislative agreements that directly affect electricity tariffs paid by consumers.

item.title: Números do PIB refletem o ciclo eleitoral
item.description: Brazil's GDP grew 1.1% in the first quarter of 2026 compared to the same period in 2025, marking a significant acceleration after three quarters of weak growth (0.3%, 0.1%, and 0.3%). This recovery suggests a possible impact of the electoral cycle, with economic stimulus or expectations of political change boosting activity. The contrast between recent performance and the prior trend indicates volatility tied to the political-electoral environment.

item.title: Vasco recebe o Atlético-MG buscando paz antes de semestre intenso
item.description: Vasco faces Atlético-MG in a Brasileirão match that could bring calm before the World Cup break. A victory would ease fan pressure after protests and improve the team's league standing. After the World Cup, the club faces an intense second semester with Sudamericana, Copa do Brasil, transfer window activity, and internal issues including a potential SAF sale and associate election.

item.title: Debate eleitoral deve ir além dos nomes na urna
item.description: Brazil's October elections are heading toward another polarized scenario, where the presidential choice will be driven mainly by personal or ideological preferences rather than concrete proposals. Despite the importance of leadership, no single candidate will have the unilateral power to resolve the country's deep-rooted problems. The electoral debate must go beyond names on the ballot and address solutions to chronic issues.

item.title: Decisão de Gilmar impôs limites razoáveis a escolas cívico-militares
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes authorized civic-military schools in Brazil's public basic education network but established reasonable limits on their adoption. He is the rapporteur of ADIs filed by PSOL and PT against the implementation of these schools in São Paulo by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, in addition to two similar actions in Paraná and Rio Grande do Sul reported by Minister Dias Toffoli. His vote serves as a guide for the STF's future stance on the issue.

item.title: Vitória contra escala 6x1 mostra que proximidade da eleição faz milagres
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved in first round a Constitutional Amendment Proposal (PEC) to reduce the workweek from 44 to 40 hours within up to 14 months and allow the end of the 6x1 shift schedule, passing with 472 votes in favor and 22 against. The proposal reflects growing pressure for better working conditions, particularly in an election year.

item.title: Esquerda usa Judiciário como extensão de seu projeto, diz Marinho
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign team accused the Brazilian left of using the judiciary as an extension of its political project, in response to a PSOL and Rede representation to the PGR requesting an investigation into his U.S. trip. During his meeting with President Donald Trump, Bolsonaro succeeded in getting the U.S. to designate PCC and Comando Vermelho as foreign terrorist organizations, a move criticized by the Brazilian federal government as a threat to national sovereignty.

item.title: NoPing leva experiência com jogos online ao Abrint 2026
item.description: NoPing attended the Abrint Global Congress 2026 in São Paulo to showcase its online gaming connection optimization technology and attract partnerships with internet providers. The company highlighted the 80% growth in Brazil’s gamer population between 2024 and 2025 and demonstrated, with pro player Coldzera, how latency directly impacts gaming performance. Its B2B strategy leverages its global infrastructure across over 150 countries to deliver intelligent routing solutions to telecom operators.

item.title: "Estranho é Tarcísio elogiar", diz Haddad sobre ação de Flávio nos EUA
item.description: Fernando Haddad, PT's pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, criticized Tarcísio de Freitas for praising Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's effort to have the U.S. designate PCC and CV as terrorist organizations, calling it harmful to bilateral cooperation and against national interests. Haddad argued that dealing with criminal factions should fall under public security, not national defense, and emphasized that Brazil-U.S. relations have always been cooperative without conflict.

item.title: O plano que Moro teve que rever para receber Flávio Bolsonaro em Curitiba
item.description: Senator Sergio Moro had planned a large reception at Curitiba airport for Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, to demonstrate support for his own gubernatorial campaign in Paraná. The event, expected to draw 400 supporters, was canceled one day prior after revelations about Flávio Bolsonaro's ties to banker Daniel Vorcaro weakened his national candidacy.

item.title: Trump quer dominar o Brasil. O que os brasileiros acham disso?
item.description: Donald Trump is leveraging Section 301 trade sanctions and the designation of criminal groups as terrorists to pressure Brazil, aiming to interfere in the 2026 election and expand U.S. influence across Latin America. The Lula administration and government agencies are preparing for potential economic retaliation, while the Bolsonaro family is accused of collaborating with this foreign strategy, deepening national divisions.

item.title: Caiado: “O projeto maior é bater o Lula”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated he is in talks with Romeu Zema about a possible alliance for the 2026 elections, emphasizing the priority of avoiding divisions on the right in the first round. He said the 'bigger project' is defeating Lula, though he noted the dialogue remains in an early stage.

item.title: Flávio faz 'papel de pirralho no cenário internacional', diz Haddad
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT), former Finance Minister and pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is playing the role of a 'brat on the international stage' and criticized his subservience to the United States. The comment was made today, reflecting criticism of the senator's foreign policy stance.

item.title: Entenda a confusão no Paraguai envolvendo painel de Bolsonaro batendo em jogador do Palmeiras
item.description: AI-generated images depicting Jair Bolsonaro assaulting Paraguayan footballer Gustavo Gómez were displayed on billboards in Ciudad del Este, on the Brazil-Paraguay border, sparking local outrage and damage to the structures. The montage, featuring nationalist slogans like 'Here is Brazil, respect!' and 'The hexa is ours,' was blamed on hacker intrusions by the advertising companies. Paraguayan President Santiago Peña condemned the act as disrespectful and ordered removal of the installations, while Flávio Bolsonaro also rejected the initiative.

item.title: "Projeto é bater o Lula", diz Caiado ao comentar negociação com Zema
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that the main goal of negotiations with Romeu Zema (Novo) is to defeat Lula in the 2026 elections, avoiding fragmentation of the center-right. He emphasized seeking an agreement before the first round, but ensuring alignment in the second round to secure victory over the PT. The PSD is also considering a pure-party ticket with Gilberto Kassab as vice-presidential candidate.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio Bolsonaro reage após governistas pedirem investigação à PGR
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign team rejected a petition filed by Psol and Rede Sustentabilidade lawmakers to the PGR, requesting an investigation into his meeting with Donald Trump and his alleged role in urging the U.S. to designate PCC and CV as terrorist organizations. The team called the move a political exploitation of the judiciary by the left and affirmed that seeking international cooperation to combat criminal factions is a legitimate and necessary act to protect national security.

item.title: Em meio a rumores de composição com Zema, Caiado defende unidade da centro-direita
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado advocated for center-right unity amid rumors of a potential alliance with Romeu Zema (Novo), stating they are in dialogue to avoid fragmentation and aim for alignment in the runoff, with the primary goal of defeating Lula and the PT. He left open the possibility of a pre-first-round agreement, with a meeting expected in early July. PSD national president Gilberto Kassab also acknowledged the possibility of a pure-blood ticket.

item.title: Moro e Dallagnol se viram do avesso por Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Sergio Moro's candidacy for governor of Paraná turned into an 'anti-climax' by aligning with Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting a widespread perception that Brazilian politics is trapped in cycles of corruption and stagnation. Deltan Dallagnol, former Lava Jato prosecutor, also joined this front, reinforcing the critique that even figures once seen as symbols of integrity now contribute to political decay. The text states: 'nothing is created, nothing is transformed, everything is corrupted'.

item.title: Como, em poucos meses, João Campos perdeu o favoritismo em Pernambuco
item.description: João Campos, former mayor of Recife and previously the frontrunner for Pernambuco’s governorship, rapidly lost his advantage over Governor Raquel Lyra due to her rising approval ratings driven by public security improvements and better communication. Recent polls show Lyra leading in a potential runoff with 51% to Campos’ 44%, after gaining 9 points while he lost 8 in just one month. The shift is striking: in August 2023, Campos had a 31-point lead in the first round, which dropped to 8 points last month and has now reversed.

item.title: Flávio se manifesta sobre outdoor de Bolsonaro agredindo Gustavo Gómez
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro condemned a billboard in Paraguay that displayed an AI-generated image of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, attacking footballer Gustavo Gómez of Palmeiras. He called the montage criminal and offensive to both the athlete and the Paraguayan people, noting Gómez is a beloved player for his father’s favorite team. Flávio also directly addressed Paraguayan President Santiago Peña on social media, denouncing the use of Jair Bolsonaro’s image to provoke Paraguay.

item.title: Carlos diz que prisão domiciliar evita que soluços do pai piorem
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro said house arrest prevents his father Jair Bolsonaro's hiccup crises from worsening after visiting him in Brasília. He noted the former president is being adequately monitored and that Alexandre de Moraes has about 20 days left to decide on a return to prison. Carlos described his father as 'very strong' and reaffirmed his support during his travels across Brazil.

item.title: 'Buscamos que não haja desagregação da centro-direita', afirma Caiado sobre negociações com Zema
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that negotiations with Romeu Zema (Novo) aim to prevent the fragmentation of the center-right, prioritizing unity to defeat the PT and Lula in the 2026 presidential runoff. He said dialogue continues and a meeting is expected in early July, though no date has been confirmed. Caiado also endorsed the ticket of Gabriel Souza (MDB) for Rio Grande do Sul governor, alongside Governor Eduardo Leite.

item.title: Decisão dos EUA sobre PCC e CV vai afetar o Pix? Veja perguntas e respostas
item.description: The U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations has raised concerns in the Lula government about potential impacts on Pix, including the risk of international financial sanctions. Authorities fear the measure could affect transactions through Brazil's instant payment system, despite no direct evidence linking Pix to these criminal groups. The government is assessing diplomatic actions to mitigate risks to the national financial system.

item.title: Sebastião Coelho deixa UTI após cirurgia no coração. Veja vídeo
item.description: Lawyer and retired judge Sebastião Coelho, a Senate pré-candidate for the Federal District from the Novo party, announced he has left the ICU after successful heart surgery. He said he expects to be discharged soon and resume activities in two to three days, emphasizing his commitment to 'save Brazil'. Coelho is known for defending Filipe Martins, former aide to Jair Bolsonaro, and for being a critic of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Lula propõe resgate do verde e amarelo pela esquerda e critica apropriação bolsonarista
item.description: President Lula urged the left to reclaim Brazil's green and yellow colors from Bolsonarist appropriation during the launch of the Tela Brasil streaming platform in Rio de Janeiro. He stressed the need for 'political culture' to engage citizens in candidate selection and criticized the dismantling of PT cultural policies, noting the expansion of Culture Points from 4,000 to 16,000. Lula also indirectly referenced the Rio gubernatorial race, calling for popular election of the state governor.

item.title: Kassab diz ser possível sair como vice de Caiado na chapa do PSD
item.description: PSD president Gilberto Kassab confirmed he could be named as vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado’s (PSD) 2026 ticket, though he stated the final decision will be made in July and may involve an ally instead. He said he is ready to accept any collective party decision, emphasizing that the choice will aim to maximize electoral success and governability. Kassab also noted he had previously been considered as a vice-presidential candidate on a ticket led by Tarcísio de Freitas, but the São Paulo governor chose to run for re-election in his state.

item.title: Lula: Brasil vive momento de “respeitabilidade” internacional
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil is experiencing an unprecedented moment of international recognition and respectability, attributing this to overcoming the 'vira-lata complex' historically held by the Brazilian elite. He emphasized the importance of national culture, citing cinema as a tool of symbolic sovereignty, and called for reclaiming national symbols like green and yellow, wrongly associated only with the opposition. Lula also reaffirmed his stance of not submitting to U.S. pressure, referencing the government’s rejection of the U.S. designation of certain groups as terrorist organizations as a defense of national sovereignty.

item.title: Tela Brasil: streaming público estreia com mais de 550 obras
item.description: President Lula launched Tela Brasil, a free public streaming platform featuring over 550 Brazilian audiovisual works, developed by the Ministry of Culture in partnership with UFAL. The initiative aims to democratize access to national culture, counter foreign low-quality content, and strengthen cultural identity. Backed by R$ 9 million invested between 2024 and 2025, it is integrated into Gov.br and will be available in future public housing units.

item.title: Margareth: governo Lula não precisa de “produtora de mentira”
item.description: Culture Minister Margareth Menez implicitly criticized the film 'Dark Horse', a Jair Bolsonaro biopic financed by Daniel Vorcaro, stating the government does not need a 'lie factory' to define Brazilian identity. First Lady Janja Lula da Silva emphasized that authentic Brazilian content is available on the public streaming platform Tela Brasil, launched at Rio2C with 555 titles and R$9 million in funding. President Lula also advocated for greater domestic cultural consumption, criticizing Brazilians' preference for foreign content and urging them to explore the Amazon instead of destinations like Miami.

item.title: Lula defende esquerda de verde e amarelo na Copa contra "fascistas"
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urged the Brazilian left to adopt the national colors green and yellow to prevent them from being claimed by fascist groups. Speaking at the launch of the Tela Brasil streaming platform in Rio de Janeiro, he linked the symbolism to the appropriation of the national team jersey by Bolsonaro supporters. Lula also emphasized cultural sovereignty, criticizing those who favor English over Portuguese and environmental advocates who do not visit the Amazon.

item.title: Lula elogia Couto por 'ajudar a consertar o Rio' e diz que Paes 'precisa ser eleito governador'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised Rio de Janeiro's acting governor Ricardo Couto for helping to 'fix the Rio' during the Rio2C event. He also stated that his ally Eduardo Paes 'needs to be elected governor' of the state, without naming opposition figure Douglas Ruas. Lula emphasized the need to wear Brazil's national colors as a symbol of resistance to Bolsonarism.

item.title: Esquerda tem que aprender a usar verde e amarelo na Copa, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that the left must learn to use the green and yellow colors in the World Cup to prevent them from being appropriated by fascist groups. He made the comment during the launch of the Tela Brasil streaming platform in Rio de Janeiro, emphasizing the symbolic importance of Brazil's national colors.

item.title: Após saída de Pacheco, PT de Minas abre debate sobre candidatura própria ao governo
item.description: The Minas Gerais PT launched an internal debate on running its own gubernatorial candidate after Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) withdrew, a figure previously endorsed by Lula to lead a broad front. The party’s State Executive Committee resolution aims to organize a governista-aligned alternative amid rising polarization between democratic and Bolsonarist forces. It also reaffirms priorities including Lula’s reelection, Marília Campos’ Senate bid, and expanding PT and allied legislative representation.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro é terrorista?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, senator and son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, is described as an ally of Rodrigo Bacellar, former president of the Alerj, whose alleged link to the Red Command was identified by the Federal Police as 'head of the political nucleus' of the faction. The content implies an indirect association between Flávio Bolsonaro and organized crime through this connection, without directly accusing him of being a terrorist. The reference to the PF and the Red Command raises the accusation to an institutional level of gravity.

item.title: Lula diz que Ricardo Couto vai “ajudar a consertar o Rio de Janeiro”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva praised Rio de Janeiro's interim governor Ricardo Couto (PSB) during the launch of the Tela Brasil platform, calling for a round of applause and stating that Couto would 'help fix Rio de Janeiro'. The event took place after Cláudio Castro's resignation to run for Senate in 2026 and on the same day it was revealed that the Institutional Security Bureau had found wiretaps in the governor's office.

item.title: Lula não poupou esforços (e recursos) na ofensiva pelo fim da escala 6×1
item.description: President Lula invested R$80 million in government advertising to promote the constitutional amendment reducing the workweek from 6×1 to 5×2, approved by the Chamber of Deputies, as part of his 2026 re-election strategy. The measure, framed as a defense of workers — especially women — faces Senate resistance, particularly from the PL and Flávio Bolsonaro, who advocate hourly pay and accuse the government of misusing public funds to boost his campaign.

item.title: Lula pede que esquerda use verde e amarelo na Copa contra “fascistas”
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) urged the left to wear Brazil's green and yellow colors during the 2026 World Cup to prevent far-right groups from appropriating national symbols. He stated that the colors must not be taken by 'fascists' and cited Rio Mayor Eduardo Cavalieri as someone who should wear the national team jersey with a disclaimer that the colors are not Bolsonarist. Lula also defended Brazilian cultural sovereignty, criticized the dominance of low-quality foreign media, and encouraged Brazilians to explore domestic wonders like the Amazon instead of traveling to Miami.

item.title: "Chora mais": aliado de Trump ironiza Lula após fala sobre CV e PCC
item.description: Jason Miller, a Donald Trump ally, mocked Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva after Lula criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for urging the U.S. to designate Brazil’s PCC and CV gangs as foreign terrorist organizations. Miller responded with 'Cry harder' and the 'womp womp' meme to ridicule Lula’s condemnation of Bolsonaro’s actions as treason. The U.S. had designated the PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations two days after Flávio Bolsonaro met with Trump at the White House.
